query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_employees,
  COUNT(DISTINCT email) as unique_emails,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN email IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_emails,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN firstName IS NULL OR lastName IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_names,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN position IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_positions,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN department IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_departments
FROM employees;
